summary: node1 now serves `secure-os-comparison-ready` over trusted HTTPS at https://10.100.63.10:8443/. Configuration survived the mandatory node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled Apache with TLS support.
Generated a node-local CA and CA-signed server certificate containing the node IP and hostname SANs.
Added the CA to AlmaLinux's system trust store.
Persistently opened TCP port 8443 in firewalld.
Rebooted node1 and verified complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: HTTPS on TCP 8443 returns the required content using a system-trusted certificate
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, direct requests to 10.100.63.10:8443 returned HTTP 200, exact body `secure-os-comparison-ready`, and `ssl_verify_result=0`; certificate verification reported OK.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID 717db5a2-895d-4bfb-b8a8-d4891c7b7b01, received native reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID 352b95fb-e90e-42ba-b10e-1c6f65f3f974, then confirmed system health, enabled/active Apache, listener, firewall persistence, trusted TLS, and content recovery.
